entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Blazor support for IC devices #70609
  • dotnet-getdocument: make the hardcoded 2-minute process / 1-minute per-document timeouts configurable #70588
  • OpenAPI document paths ignore RouteOptions.LowercaseUrls for [controller] routes in .NET 11 #70584

PullRequests

Created

  • Honor string defaults for explicit query header and route binding #70608
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Preserve signed-zero request delegate defaults #70607
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Preserve literal single-segment gRPC transcoding variables #70606
    area-grpc, community-contribution
  • Skip missing parameter syntax for metadata route handlers #70605
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution
  • Persist passkey AAGUIDs in both EF Core stores #70604
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Distinguish comma-containing values in query cache keys #70603
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • Preserve properties replaced by the WS-Federation token event #70602
    area-auth, community-contribution
  • Create an independent default WebSocket accept context #70601
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Keep infinite Kestrel timeouts from overflowing their deadlines #70600
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Reject overflowing HTTP chunk sizes as bad requests #70599
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Guard unresolved route usage contexts in the route analyzer #70598
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution
  • Cancel Redis output-cache garbage collection delays on disposal #70597
    community-contribution, area-middleware
  • Normalize nullable enum defaults before OpenAPI serialization #70596
    community-contribution, area-minimal
  • Stop JSON Patch moves when source removal fails #70595
    community-contribution
  • Report failed persistence from the Identity two-factor API #70594
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Avoid ASP0022 for method-specific routes beside Map #70593
    area-infrastructure, community-contribution
  • Include the request base path in tag-helper globbing cache keys #70592
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • Normalize unbracketed IPv6 hosts in ToUriComponent #70591
    community-contribution, area-networking
  • Reacquire UTF-8 writer memory after Flush advances the buffer #70590
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • Fix nested wildcard host endpoint selection #70589
    community-contribution, area-routing
  • [release/11.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #70587
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #70586
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #70585
    area-infrastructure, area-blazor, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops

Updated

  • Fence frozen-bundle review skill off from CCR and adapt domain skills for source-only PR review #70581
  • Automatically marshal cancellation arguments in JSInterop #70328
    area-blazor
  • Allow rotating the cookie session key on sign-in #70105
    area-auth, community-contribution, pending-ci-rerun
  • Reduce per-call overhead in UserValidator #70224
    area-identity, pending-ci-rerun
  • Stabilize CacheTagHelper concurrent awaiter tests #70274
    area-mvc, pending-ci-rerun
  • Fix WebHost logging configuration test isolation #70279
    pending-ci-rerun, area-hosting
  • Stabilize hostname address registration tests #70293
    pending-ci-rerun, area-networking
  • Allow draft PRs to defer originating and API proposal issues #70313
    pending-ci-rerun
